name: go-invoicing-renderer
description: Invoice-template rendering service (custom invoice layouts, Phases 1 and 4). Renders a template + invoice data to HTML — either the system Classic template's own hardcoded HTML, or a real saved template interpreted via Puck's Render component (see src/renderTemplate.jsx) — then prints that HTML to PDF via headless Chromium. A deliberately separate Node service, not folded into web/ or the Go API — the Go API's own production image stays Node-free (see Dockerfile/README's 'no Node runtime' guarantee); this is the one place in the project that legitimately needs Node + a browser engine at request time.
